# ThaiEar

> A free Thai-language listening platform: real, natural Thai sentences organised by topic and difficulty, with native-speed audio, English translations, and word-by-word notes.

ThaiEar teaches Thai through complete sentences (not vocabulary lists). Every topic ramps from Beginner to Intermediate. Each sentence page shows the Thai, an English translation, and a gloss of each word, with native-speed audio to build listening comprehension.
